machine.method: Instrumented Swing readiness, no forced GC; graceful platform exit saves settings and VFS between cached launches. Fresh application config is not cold OS cache. Includes attach/poll overhead.

limits: Real 2381-commit 231-file history; not a 100000-commit log benchmark
Log readiness is first usable graph, not exhaustive paging through all commits
Fresh refers to application config/index cache; repository IDE metadata and OS cache persist between iterations
Diff timing includes selection, loading, Attach and polling overhead
No valid old-ZIP large-repository sample exists because its first attempt logged an exception; no speedup claim from that failed run
